newsitem.title: MEXICO: Two dead as gunmen clash with Mexican army.
newsitem.headline: Two dead as gunmen clash with Mexican army.

text.p: A Mexican soldier was shot to death and an assailant was killed on Wednesday during a clash between troops and unidentified gunmen in the mountains in the southern state of Guerrero, the military said.

Mexican television news reports said the gunmen were suspected members of the rebel Popular Revolutionary Army (EPR), which has appeared frequently since last year near the town of Coyuca de Benitez where the skirmish occurred.

In a statement, the Defence Ministry said troops from the 56th Infantry Battalion based in Guerrero's tourist resort of Acapulco were fired on by the gunmen, and the soldier, Luis Eduin Barrera Banos, was killed.

It said the army was sweeping the area to hunt down the attackers. The EPR, which launched deadly attacks last August in Guerrero and other states, has said it was now avoiding conflict where possible while recruiting followers.
